name: Snippet
description: A copyable shell command with a prompt that stays out of the copy.

keyboard: Tab reaches the copy button; Enter or Space copies the commands without the prompt.
ariaRequirements: The $ prompt is aria-hidden chrome; screen readers hear only the command.
Each command is a code element; the copy button is named "Copy code" by default.
a11y.reviewedNote: 2026-10-25: built from the Figma component (Astryx Code/CodeBlock and Geist code/code-block/snippet benchmarks) to replace CodeBlockWindow and CodeSnippet.

forbiddenUse: Use for multi-line source code or command output; use CodeBlock.
dense: copyable shell command(s) with a $ prompt excluded from copy; default or inverted (dark) theme

usage.description: Snippet holds a command the reader will paste into a terminal. Pass the bare command: the prompt is drawn for you and never copied. Several commands render one per line and copy together.

bestPractices.description: Write the command only; the component draws the $ prompt.
Use inverted for terminal emphasis on a light page.
Do not type $ into command; it would copy and render twice.
Do not put source files or output in a Snippet; use CodeBlock.

command.description:
The command, or several commands shown one per line. Write the command
only: the prompt is chrome and never part of the text.

prompt.description: Show the `$` prompt before each command. Copy always leaves it out.

theme.description:
`inverted` renders the snippet in the dark theme on any page, for
terminal emphasis. In the high-contrast themes it follows the page so
contrast stays at the high-contrast level.

copyLabel.description: Accessible name for the copy button.

onCopy.description: Called with the copied text (commands joined by newlines).
